name: How much does it cost to fix a sewage backup in the shower?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to fix a sewage backup in the shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to fix a sewage backup varies widely depending on the cause and severity of the blockage. Simple clogs might be resolved with snaking for a few hundred dollars. However, more complex issues like tree root removal, damaged pipes requiring excavation, or extensive main sewer line repairs can range from several hundred to several thousand dollars. A professional plumber will provide an estimate after diagnosing the specific problem.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on the cause and severity, from a few hundred for simple clogs to several thousand for main line repairs. A plumber will provide an estimate.
